capability.title: Budget & Policy Guard
capability.summary: Called before every billable step. Returns allow / downgrade / deny. Centralising this is what lets a tenant cap be enforced across forty workflows without forty copies of the same arithmetic.

with.code: return [{ json: { error: { code: 'BUDGET_EXCEEDED', message: `Projected spend ${$json.projected_minor_units} exceeds cap ${$json.cap_minor_units}`, retryable: false, at: new Date().toISOString() } } }];
